author: cens0r3d
name: VCStatus
description: Automatically set configurable status messages on voice channels when members join or leave. Supports per-channel messages, {count} placeholder for live member count, per-guild configuration.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not store any end user data. All settings are guild-specific and stored in Red's Config.
install_msg: Thanks for installing VCStatus! Use `[p]vcstatus` to configure the feature. Requires the bot to have **Manage Channels** permission on voice channels.
short: Auto voice channel status on join
